weekend_note: Another dry, sunny stretch: highs around 77 to 81 with rain chances in the single digits through Tuesday, so the weekend is a good one for outdoor plans. Picks: free Opera After Dark Friday and SevilleStock Saturday downtown, Hunter Hayes at the Interstate Fair, Boo at the Zoo, and CeCe Winans on Thursday and Ice Flyers on Saturday, both indoors at the Bay Center. Taste of Gulf Breeze was canceled after the storm; this week's beach movie and band nights were reported canceled earlier.

news.title: Escambia debris pickup tops 330,000 cubic yards
news.summary: The county has collected about 330,000 cubic yards of Isaias debris, with roughly 2 million estimated remaining and a cost estimate of $52 to $54 million that FEMA is expected to help reimburse. Much vegetative debris is being chipped into mulch.

news.title: SailGP opens North American training base in Pensacola
news.summary: SailGP and American Magic set up a training base at American Magic's Pensacola center under a six-season deal. The Great Britain team is already here and more teams are expected.

news.title: UWF hosts Freedom Trucks mobile museum through Oct 22
news.summary: An America250 traveling exhibit is on UWF's campus in Lot B from 10 AM to 5 PM through Thursday. The article does not give a price.

news.title: Barktoberfest rescheduled to Nov 15
news.summary: The Humane Society's 20th annual dog event moves to Seville Square and Fountain Park, 10 AM to 4 PM, with free admission.

news.title: Governor asks FEMA for disaster declaration; state brings travel trailers
news.summary: DeSantis said the state requested a federal declaration for eight counties. Nearly 300 trailer applications came in across four counties, and $5,000 grants began going to affected first responders.

news.title: City of Pensacola: recycling returns Oct 26, 14 parks reopen
news.summary: The Oct 19 update says curbside recycling resumes Oct 26 and 14 parks have reopened as debris collection continues.

news.title: Taste of Gulf Breeze canceled; tickets refunded
news.summary: The Gulf Breeze Chamber canceled the Oct 23 event as recovery continues. No new date is set and ticket purchases are being refunded.

news.title: Costco construction underway on East Nine Mile Road
news.summary: NorthEscambia.com's homepage lists construction as underway at 225 East Nine Mile Road. No opening date was given.

coverage_note: Written overnight Wednesday Oct 21. Weather is Fox Weather's forecast as of 2:54 AM Oct 20 (the freshest I could open); it runs through Oct 27 and I left out Oct 28 because no source gave a rain chance. Events come from Must Do Pensacola, Local Pulse, Visit Pensacola, the downtown events calendar and the fair lineup. Several downtown calendar items list no start time, so they say 'See event page'. NorthEscambia.com's homepage showed no upcoming Gonzalez, Molino, Beulah or Cantonment events, so those listings are carried over from Allevents and were not rechecked. Saenger, Ice Flyers and Blue Wahoos sites were not opened. No restaurant openings were confirmed; Pelican, Casa Luvia and Launch remain unconfirmed. The fair's Oct 30 act is listed as Colt Ford in the official lineup but LOCASH in one local calendar.
